title: WorkerPublishRunAck
description: The response to a successful worker POST /push or POST /publish: the resolved public links and whether the run was newly recorded/published. Both are idempotent, so a re-push or re-publish of a run already in that state succeeds with `newlyPublished: false`.

sourceRepo.description: The public repository URL holding the run's released source.

playableBuild.description: The deployment URL the build tool reported, recorded verbatim. Present only when a static build was produced and deployed; omitted otherwise.

newlyPublished.description: Whether this call newly recorded the run (true), or was an idempotent re-publish of one already recorded (false).
